name: line-signature-write
title: Signature Stroke
description: Ba nét của chữ ký được viết theo thứ tự: chữ cái đầu, phần nối rồi gạch chân, nét viết xong vẫn giữ lại.

moworks.author: takayu

options.windows: [from, to] s per stroke, in writing order

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio svg-signature, written here): Three paths, pathLength 1, dashoffset 1 -> 0 in writing order, ease-in-out: initial 0.25-0.9 s, connected letters 0.85-1.6 s, underline 1.55-2.05 s (recipe: 8-34 %, 32-64 %, 62-84 % of the loop); strokes overlap slightly and stay drawn; 4.5 px strokes, underline 3 px in the second colour; a small pen dot rides the active tip. All fade 2.9-3.25 s. Params: strokes (3) · windows: giờ từng nét · width (4.5 / 3 px).
moworks.titleVi: Chữ ký viết lần lượt từng nét
